Posts labelled only 'Grades K-4' (Mueller, Abbott) name no building (elementary school and annex both serve K-4) so unknown. Maternity-leave line 46 ignored; page number 50. Integration pass, 31 Oct 2026: school bus contractors, drivers and volunteers moved from entries to ignored (not school staff; every 1971-1980 page treated alike), and `middle` written `turkey-hill` -- the 1972 and 1974 listings print the building as `Turkey Hill Middle School (Grades 5-7)`, the town's one middle school.
